headline: Taishan announces tainted oil case, Jiekou Investment impairment; H1 loss NT$787 million - Finance
summary: Taishan halted trading and held a material information press conference, citing the tainted oil incident. The company reported an H1 loss of NT$787 million, including losses on an investment in Zhonglian Oil & Fats and an impairment on Jiekou Financial prepaid funds.
why: Taishan is a Taiwanese food company, and food-safety scandals and impairments can hit earnings, liquidity and consumer confidence.
why_moved: The company cited losses from the tainted oil incident, an investment loss at Zhonglian Oil & Fats and an impairment on Jiekou Financial prepaid funds. Trading was halted on the day of the announcement.
